title.narrative: Towards a Decentralised Waste Management Integrated Response

description.narrative: This project is designed to support Lebanons waste management systems in a time in which the country is plagued by multiple crises. The all-embracing objective of the project (Impact) is to improve the overall environmental and financial sustainability of Lebanons waste management system by focusing on several special streams, in particular healthcare wastes.
